x_note: ADR-0011 section 5 (N-2). Documented expectations only. Stage 107A implements this.
where_it_lives: project-level control-plane setting; changed only by an explicit recorded operator action; each authorization binds the mode at issuance

agent_local_minimum.semantics: narrowing only; refuses authorizations below it; cannot upgrade one

defaults.no_silent_legacy: A project or agent that wants legacy_partial must set it explicitly; it is never the silent default.

legacy_partial.purpose: migration compatibility for the validated v1 path
legacy_partial.local_substitutions: permitted only where the artifact leaves the value undeclared; listed as local_substitutions
legacy_partial.evidence: every authorization, context and evidence record carries f2_status = partial_hardening

required.issuance: refused unless the projection is required-complete for the node platform
required.agent_execution: declared execution semantics only; any local substitution attempt => blocked_local_policy_substitution
required.external_input_verification: image identity and configuration content verified before any create / recreate / start; mismatch => blocked_external_input_mismatch
required.evidence: f2_status = closed only if the ADR-0011 closure conditions hold

v2_slices: always execution_pinning_mode = required; legacy_partial exists only on the v1 path
